workload: Fully-asynchronous multi-turn agentic GRPO on a 16A3B-class MoE policy (Miles + SGLang + Megatron), 16 GPUs split 8 train / 8 rollout across two pods. Each trajectory is a multi-turn tool-using episode in a remote sandbox; conversation history grows past 10k tokens.

run-a.log_coverage: pod-console tail only (last 2000 master lines, ~17:17-17:41) + 270 worker lines; the in-process console capture for this run is empty

run-b.log_coverage: in-process console capture (~2 h) + pod-console tail to job end

notes: Labels are neutral; they do not encode any external identifier.
Each run's console log is in run-*/master.log.gz and run-*/worker.log.gz (JSONL: t, pod, msg).
